evidence.title: Diagnose and remediate reachable GO-2026-6809 stdlib trust vulnerability with patched Go 1.26.10
evidence.goal: Resolve the observed mandatory CHK-SCA-GO blocker in #195: expose only strictly validated public GO advisory IDs in failure messages, then upgrade all nine existing Go module/toolchain declarations from 1.26.8/1.26.9 to official Go 1.26.10, fixed for crypto/x509 Certificate.Verify (GO-2026-6809), without touching product code or disabling any security control.
outputs: Strictly validated public advisory reference in failed SCA CI on exact HEAD, or identifier-unavailable; actionable module remediation can then be scoped to verified OSV
Unit tests prove identity redaction and no change to fail-closed classification
Nine exact Go go.mod declarations raised to 1.26.10; engineering-kernel and all runtime workflows should now build/reassess with fixed standard library without modifying product Go source.

Mandatory Event Inspection E2E source drift gate now permits only the exact two documented Go 1.26.8 -> 1.26.10 go.mod blob SHAs, requires actual go test ./... and go vet ./... under patched local compiler; all other source changes fail closed; original historical VERIFIED SHA stays immutable and runtime_unchanged_since_pivot=false.
acceptance_tests: parseGovulncheckStream still returns error and actionable count for a reachable OSV, now safe identifier
Module path, private symbol, package, raw scanner output never appear in error
Malformed/missing labels never leak and never pass
Exact-head engineering kernel failure reports only safe public advisory ID; vulnerability remains block until actual fix
All nine existing go.mod paths contain go 1.26.10 and no pre-1.26.10 go directives remain in registered runtime modules.
Go vulnerability scanner no longer reports reachable GO-2026-6809 on exact HEAD; SCA stays mandatory and fails on other actionable findings.
Command runtime Linux/macOS/Windows and engineering kernel exact HEAD CI pass after patch, including existing defensive tests.
Source identity gate accepts unchanged original runtime or single exact Go 1.26.10 go.mod delta but rejects different Go version or extra source file in isolated test Git repository
On exact candidate SHA CHK-EVENT-INSPECTION-E2E outputs PASS with runtime_unchanged_since_pivot=false; all historical evidence unmodified and mandatory SCA remains enforced.

rules: Strict tenant isolation and permission checking
